summary: The diff implements partial changes for the three requirements. REQ-16 (frontend hook logging) appears well-implemented. REQ-14 (backend admin principal fix) is partially implemented but uses a different authorization mechanism (AccessControl module) rather than a direct isCallerAdmin function comparing caller.toText() against the hardcoded string. REQ-15 (migration.mo) is technically added but is essentially a no-op stub that does not actually overwrite the admin principal during upgrade.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the stored admin principal is exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'. The isCallerAdmin comparison must use caller.toText() and compare it directly against this string. If the admin principal is held in a stable variable, set its default/initial value to this principal so it is authoritative on upgrade.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff shows authorization is delegated to an AccessControl module (AccessControl.hasPermission / AccessControl.isAdmin) and a MixinAuthorization. There is no visible isCallerAdmin function using caller.toText() compared against the hardcoded principal string. The stable variable holding the admin principal and its initialization to the required value are not shown, and AccessControl.initState() does not visibly set this principal.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create or update backend/migration.mo to overwrite the live canister's stored admin principal with 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' during the next canister upgrade, without losing any other stable state.
missing_requirements.reason: The added backend/migration.mo is a trivial stub: it takes an empty record and returns it unchanged. It does not receive or modify any stable state including the admin principal. The AC requires migration.mo to write the correct admin principal to the stable admin variable on upgrade and preserve all other stable state, neither of which this stub accomplishes.

hallucinated_features.description: Refactored backend to use an AccessControl module and MixinAuthorization mixin instead of the specified isCallerAdmin pattern
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifically requires isCallerAdmin to use caller.toText() compared against the hardcoded string. Instead, the diff introduces AccessControl.hasPermission, AccessControl.isAdmin, AccessControl.initState(), and MixinAuthorization, representing an architectural change beyond what was asked.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend uses MixinStorage blob storage integration
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff shows include MixinStorage() and import MixinStorage from blob-storage/Mixin which were not part of the admin principal fix requirements.
